title: Episode 263: 🇳🇱 The Sean Parent Origin Story

sentences.en: I wrote programs in notebooks and executed them in my head.
sentences.zh: 我以前在笔记本上写程序，然后全在脑子里运行。

sentences.en: Goddamn, you're Bill Gates.
sentences.zh: 靠，你简直就是比尔·盖茨。

sentences.en: And made fairly significant money for ninth graders.
sentences.zh: 而且对于初三学生来说，这赚得算是一大笔钱了。

sentences.en: My two top computers that I was looking at were the Ohio Scientific Challenger and the Exidy Sorcerer.
sentences.zh: 我当时主要看中的两台电脑是 Ohio Scientific Challenger 和 Exidy Sorcerer。

sentences.en: There was a lot of Apple II software that appeared in this time frame that had stamped on it, cracked by Serpent.
sentences.zh: 那个时期有很多 Apple II 软件，上面都印着“由 Serpent 破解”。

sentences.en: And Serpent was, my initials are SRP, so it was SRP-E-N-T.
sentences.zh: 而 Serpent 嘛，我的名字缩写是 SRP，所以就是 S-R-P-E-N-T。

sentences.en: So Serpent was me.
sentences.zh: 所以 Serpent 就是我。

sentences.en: A computer class with no computers is...
sentences.zh: 一个没有电脑的电脑课……

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And we spent like the next 72 hours writing code on a Mac Plus and 68K assembly language with no docs and just a debugger to figure out API calls.
sentences.zh: 然后我们花了差不多接下来的 72 小时，在 Mac Plus 上用 68K 汇编语言写代码，没有文档，只有一个调试器来摸索 API 调用。

sentences.en: Welcome to ADSP, the podcast, episode 263, recorded on October 10th, 2025.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看 ADSP 播客第 263 期，录制于 2025 年 10 月 10 日。

sentences.en: My name is Connor, and today with my co-host Bryce, we continue our chaotic conversation with Sean Parent
sentences.zh: 我是康纳，今天我和我的联合主持人布莱斯，将继续我们与肖恩·帕伦特的随性交谈，

sentences.en: and get the origin story pre-Adobe, pre-Apple, and pre-Orange Micro and find out where Sean Parent came from.
sentences.zh: 探寻他在加入 Adobe、Apple 乃至 Orange Micro 之前的起源故事，并了解肖恩·帕伦特是怎么来的。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm thinking that you, Connor, you will be the official Sean Parent biographer.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得你，康纳，将会成为官方的肖恩·帕伦特传记作家。

sentences.en: Well, AI will be the ghostwriter, but...
sentences.zh: 好吧，AI 会是代笔人，但是……

sentences.en: All right, we just heard some amazing stories from Sean about childhood crimes that maybe we'll get him to retell sometime.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们刚刚从肖恩那里听到了一些关于童年趣事的精彩故事，也许我们以后能让他重新讲讲。

sentences.en: Yeah, you can retell that, but...
sentences.zh: 对，你可以重新讲讲，但是……

sentences.en: But we were...
sentences.zh: 但我们当时……

sentences.en: Connor was just asking Sean how he went from living in rural Washington to programming, right?
sentences.zh: 康纳刚刚在问肖恩，他是怎么从华盛顿州农村生活走到编程这一步的，对吧？

sentences.en: Because you grew up in a fairly rural area, and...
sentences.zh: 因为你在一个相当偏远的地区长大，而且……

sentences.en: So you might need to rewind three or four minutes.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能需要倒回三四分钟。

sentences.en: Okay, so rewinding.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们倒带。

sentences.en: So, I had a seventh grade math teacher who was a NASA engineer before she decided to become a math teacher.
sentences.zh: 那么，我初一时有个数学老师，在她决定当数学老师之前，曾是 NASA 的工程师。

sentences.en: And it was kind of an accelerated math program.
sentences.zh: 那算是一个加速数学项目。

sentences.en: And she had the policy that if we could come in, in the morning, for class, and ask a question related to mathematics and current events.
sentences.zh: 她有个规定，如果我们能在早上上课时来提一个与数学和时事相关的问题。

sentences.en: So it had to be something we found in a magazine or a newspaper or something like that, and ask her to explain it.
sentences.zh: 所以必须是我们在杂志、报纸或类似东西上找到的内容，并请她解释。

sentences.en: Then she would spend the time explaining the math behind it and answering our question.
sentences.zh: 然后她就会花时间解释背后的数学原理并回答我们的问题。

sentences.en: It specifically had to be related to current events.
sentences.zh: 具体必须与时事相关。

sentences.en: It specifically had to be related to current events.
sentences.zh: 具体必须与时事相关。

sentences.en: And as long as we could feed her questions and keep her answering, we didn't have to open the textbook and do assignments.
sentences.zh: 只要我们能不断向她提问并让她回答，我们就不用翻开课本做作业了。

sentences.en: And it was pretty incredible, because we would come up with, you know...
sentences.zh: 这简直太不可思议了，因为我们会想出，你知道的……

sentences.en: By we, you mean you.
sentences.zh: 说到“我们”，你的意思是只有你。

sentences.en: It wasn't just me.
sentences.zh: 不只是我。

sentences.en: There were a number of us.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多人。

sentences.en: So we would come up with questions.
sentences.zh: 所以我们会想出各种问题。

sentences.en: And we wouldn't always succeed in keeping her busy for the whole hour.
sentences.zh: 而且我们并不总能成功让她忙活整整一个小时。

sentences.en: But we would ask questions.
sentences.zh: 但我们会提问。

sentences.en: And she would cover things and explain them in seventh grade terMs.
sentences.zh: 她会涵盖这些内容并用初一的水平解释它们。

sentences.en: And it would include, you know, explanations of statistics and calculus and whatever was necessary to solve that problem.
sentences.zh: 其中会包括，你知道的，统计学、微积分以及解决该问题所必需的任何解释。

sentences.en: And she did an outstanding job at kind of breaking it down to a level we could grasp.
sentences.zh: 她做得极其出色，把知识点拆解到我们能理解的程度。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: Explain like I'm in grade seven.
sentences.zh: 就像我在七年级一样给我解释。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: And so that kind of laid my mathematics background and intereSt.
sentences.zh: 所以这奠定了我的数学基础和兴趣。

sentences.en: And through that, I saw the relevance of math.
sentences.zh: 通过那段经历，我看到了数学的实际意义。

sentences.en: What was her name?
sentences.zh: 她叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Her name was Ella Mae Knowles.
sentences.zh: 她叫埃拉·梅·诺尔斯。

sentences.en: I remember the name.
sentences.zh: 我记得这个名字。

sentences.en: So...
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: And it was great when...
sentences.zh: 而且很棒的是……

sentences.en: I did not graduate from high school.
sentences.zh: 我没有从高中毕业。

sentences.en: We'll get there, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想我们会聊到那里的。

sentences.en: But I did attend my class's high school graduation.
sentences.zh: 但我确实参加了我那届的高中毕业典礼。

sentences.en: And she also came.
sentences.zh: 她也来了。

sentences.en: So that was the last time I saw her was at what would have been my high school graduation.
sentences.zh: 所以那是我最后一次见到她，正是在本该属于我的高中毕业典礼上。

sentences.en: Do you think she kept tabs on you anymore?
sentences.zh: 你觉得她后来还有关注你的动向吗？

sentences.en: I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道。

sentences.en: So she hasn't kept in touch.
sentences.zh: 所以我们没有保持联系。

sentences.en: I've tried to look her up and Google her a couple times, but haven't found her.
sentences.zh: 我试过在谷歌上人肉她几次，但没找到。

sentences.en: So I don't know if she got married or remarried or what.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道她是不是结婚了、改嫁了还是怎么样。

sentences.en: Maybe the listeners will know Ella Mae Knowles, ex-NASA engineer.
sentences.zh: 也许听众里有人知道埃拉·梅·诺尔斯，这位前 NASA 工程师。

sentences.en: So specifically, I believe she worked on spacesuits for women at NASA.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我相信她曾在 NASA 从事女性宇航服的工作。

sentences.en: So in any case, that sparked a strong interest in math.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这激发了我对数学的浓厚兴趣。

sentences.en: And, you know, I had some skills in math, I guess, which is why I was in her class.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我大概也有点数学天赋，这就是为什么我在她班上吧。

sentences.en: Before that, but that was really where I saw the relevance of math and really got interested in it.
sentences.zh: 在此之前也是，但那真的是我看到数学的现实意义并真正对它产生兴趣的起点。

sentences.en: And then the same year that this is going on, my dad worked at Boeing.
sentences.zh: 然后，就在这同一年，我爸爸在波音公司工作。

sentences.en: And they offered a programming class in basic to Boeing employees.
sentences.zh: 他们为波音员工提供了一个 BASIC 编程班。

sentences.en: And it was like an evening class.
sentences.zh: 那好像是个夜校。

sentences.en: And my dad signed up for it.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸就报名了。

sentences.en: But not enough people signed up to take the course.
sentences.zh: 但报名的人数不够开班。

sentences.en: So they opened it up to family members of Boeing employees.
sentences.zh: 于是他们把名额开放给了波音员工的家属。

sentences.en: So my dad asked me if I wanted to take a course on basic programming.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸就问我想不想上基础编程课。

sentences.en: And so this would have been, I don't know, late 70s time frame, maybe like 77.
sentences.zh: 那大概是，我不知道，70 年代末期，差不多 77 年左右。

sentences.en: I had never touched a computer, never seen one in person.
sentences.zh: 我从来没摸过电脑，也没亲眼见过。

sentences.en: You know, to me, a computer was big things with reel-to-reel tapes that you saw on TV and lots of flashing lights.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，对我来说，电脑就是你在电视上看到的带着盘式磁带的大块头，还有一闪一闪的灯光。

sentences.en: So I thought this was pretty exciting that I'd get to go take the class.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时觉得能去上这门课简直太让人兴奋了。

sentences.en: And so I went and took the course.
sentences.zh: 于是我就去上了这门课。

sentences.en: And it was 100% lecture, no hands-on, never saw a computer for the entire course.
sentences.zh: 百分之百都是讲座，没有任何实际操作，整个课程期间连电脑的面都没见着。

sentences.en: The best way to learn.
sentences.zh: 最好的学习方式。

sentences.en: The best way to learn.
sentences.zh: 最好的学习方式。

sentences.en: But got handouts on basic programming.
sentences.zh: 但拿到了关于基础编程的讲义。

sentences.en: And I was, I don't know, completely obsessed with this idea that somewhere there were these machines that you would give them instructions.
sentences.zh: 而我，我不知道，完全沉迷于这样一个想法：某个地方存在着这样一些机器，你给它们下达指令。

sentences.en: And these machines would follow the instructions.
sentences.zh: 然后这些机器就会执行指令。

sentences.en: And now I knew how to give them instructions.
sentences.zh: 现在我知道怎么给它们下达指令了。

sentences.en: And I had handouts with instructions on how to give the machine instructions.
sentences.zh: 而且我手里有讲义，上面写着如何给机器下达指令的说明。

sentences.en: And so I wrote programs in notebooks and executed them in my head.
sentences.zh: 所以我把程序写在笔记本上，然后在脑子里运行它们。

sentences.en: Goddamn, you're Bill Gates.
sentences.zh: 靠，你简直就是比尔·盖茨。

sentences.en: I just, we interviewed, I can't remember who, we interviewed on ArrayCaSt.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我们采访过，我记不清是谁了，我们在 ArrayCast 上采访过。

sentences.en: And he mentioned, I can't remember the gueSt.
sentences.zh: 他提到过，我记不清是哪个嘉宾了。

sentences.en: I mean, I definitely remember the conversation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我绝对记得那次对话。

sentences.en: And he mentioned Bill Gates' first part of his two-part or three-part biography called Source Code.
sentences.zh: 他提到了比尔·盖茨两部或三部曲传记的第一部分，名叫《源代码》。

sentences.en: Can't recommend it highly enough.
sentences.zh: 强烈推荐。

sentences.en: But at some point in the book, he talks about these hikes.
sentences.zh: 但书里在某个地方，他谈到了这些远足。

sentences.en: He was a part of some Boy Scouts.
sentences.zh: 他曾参加过一些童子军活动。

sentences.en: They would go on these massive hikes.
sentences.zh: 他们会进行这种大规模的远足。

sentences.en: And he would program in his head.
sentences.zh: 而他就会在脑子里编程。

sentences.en: And then get back and have solved some problem.
sentences.zh: 然后回来时就已经解决了一些问题。

sentences.en: You're basically Bill Gates.
sentences.zh: 你基本上就是比尔·盖茨。

sentences.en: And also, it's uncanny, these, you know, all the greats of computer science lore.
sentences.zh: 而且更诡异的是，这些，你知道的，计算机科学传奇人物中的所有大佬。

sentences.en: They had access to a parent that was a prof, that had one of the first whatever.
sentences.zh: 他们都有一个当教授的父母，拥有最早的什么什么设备。

sentences.en: I've never heard the parent that was at Boeing that was offered a course, and then family members were invited.
sentences.zh: 我从没听说过哪个父母在波音工作，赶上公司开设课程，然后家属也被邀请去的。

sentences.en: But that is an alternative version of these kind of, you had to have exposure early on to...
sentences.zh: 但这是另一种版本的经历，你必须很早就接触到……

sentences.zh: C++ 里的所有人怎么都是从 BASIC 开始的？

sentences.en: I mean, me, you, like, just dozens of people.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我、你，还有，成百上千的人。

sentences.en: I don't know, it was BASIC that...
sentences.zh: 我不知道，就是 BASIC 这种……

sentences.en: BASIC is a BASIC, but it's not...
sentences.zh: BASIC 确实是 BASIC，但它又不是……

sentences.en: The BASIC, yeah.
sentences.zh: 就是那个 BASIC，对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 我以前在笔记本上写程序，然后全在脑子里运行。

sentences.en: And did that until ninth grade.
sentences.zh: 一直这么干到初三。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: How many years is that?
sentences.zh: 那是几年？

sentences.en: Two years.
sentences.zh: 两年。

sentences.en: So, like, two years.
sentences.zh: 所以，差不多两年。

sentences.en: So, like, two years, you're juSt...
sentences.zh: 所以，差不多两年，你一直在……

sentences.en: You're compiling and executing them in my head.
sentences.zh: 你在我脑子里编译并运行它们。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And then somebody...
sentences.zh: 然后有人……

sentences.en: That's how to be successful, folks.
sentences.zh: 朋友们，这就是成功的方法。

sentences.en: If you're struggling to find a job, just spend two years.
sentences.zh: 如果你找不到工作，花两年时间就行了。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 所以到了初三，有人把一台原版的 TRS-80 捐给了我们的初中。

sentences.en: So, our junior high was seventh, eighth, and ninth grade.
sentences.zh: 我们的初中包含七年级、八年级和九年级。

sentences.en: And so, I'm in ninth grade.
sentences.zh: 所以当时我上初三。

sentences.en: And a friend of mine...
sentences.zh: 然后我有个朋友……

sentences.zh: 他是我婚礼上的伴郎。

sentences.en: Best friend, Mark Matsudaira.
sentences.zh: 挚友，马克·松平。

sentences.zh: 我和他发现了这件事，然后去找了教职员工。

sentences.en: Wait, you're in grade nine?
sentences.zh: 等等，你才九年级？

sentences.zh: 你在跟学校的教职员工谈条件？

sentences.en: Of the school, yeah.

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Great.

sentences.en: Yeah, we set it up in a closet, and...

sentences.en: Okay?

sentences.zh: 那是 Basic 语言的一个稍微不同的变体，我是凭记忆和笔记来写的。

sentences.en: Uh, but yeah, I got, got these to work, and then we discovered that the TRS-80 had these very primitive kind of block graphics.
sentences.zh: 呃，不过，对，我把这些弄通了，然后我们发现 TRS-80 有这种非常原始的块状图形。

sentences.zh: 呃，我姐姐当时比我大三岁，她在西雅图大学上学。

sentences.en: And she said, well, you should just apply to the university and just, just go to Seattle U.
sentences.zh: 她说，嗯，你应该直接申请大学，去西雅图大学读书就行了。

sentences.en: You didn't need a high school diploma?
sentences.zh: 你不需要高中毕业证书吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Uh, which was my answer.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这也是我的回答。

sentences.en: And I thought, I thought you're completely nuts.
sentences.zh: 然后我想，我觉得你完全疯了。

sentences.en: I need a high school diploma.
sentences.zh: 我需要一个高中毕业证。

sentences.en: Um, there's no way, there's no way, there's no way.
sentences.zh: 呃，绝对不行，绝对不行，绝对不行。

sentences.en: But she kept hounding me about it.
sentences.zh: 但她一直为此唠叨个没完。

sentences.en: And one day she like brought home the application forms and she was like, just fill them out and send them off.
sentences.zh: 有一天她竟然把申请表拿回家，还说，填好寄出去就行了。

sentences.en: And so I did, I filled them off and I sent them into the school and I thought nothing would happen of it.
sentences.zh: 于是我照做了，填好表格寄到了学校，当时觉得压根不会有什么结果。

sentences.en: And then I got a call from the Dean of admissions, of admissions at Seattle U that asked, why are you applying?
sentences.zh: 然后我接到了西雅图大学招生办主任的电话，招生主任问，你为什么要申请？

sentences.en: It's too soon.
sentences.zh: 这太早了。

sentences.en: Uh, I explained the situation and the Dean said, well, I'm going to set you up with some interviews with professors and we'll see if this would make sense.
sentences.zh: 呃，我解释了情况，主任说，好吧，我给你安排几场教授面试，我们看看这是否行得通。

sentences.en: And so I went into Seattle, Seattle university and sat down with some professors and got interviewed
sentences.zh: 于是我去了西雅图大学，跟几位教授坐在一起接受了面试

sentences.en: and grilled and passed and got accepted, uh, uh, without a high school diploma or no GED or, or, or, or, or any equivalent.
sentences.zh: 并经受了一番严厉盘问，居然通过并被录取了，呃，呃，在没有高中毕业证、没有同等学历证明的情况下。

sentences.en: Uh, so that's how I ended up skipping and not, not getting a high school graduation, which, which both when I, every major company I've worked for, which is, is Apple, Google, and
sentences.zh: 呃，所以这就是我如何跳过高中、没有拿到高中毕业证的经过，而这在之后，我工作的每一家大公司——也就是苹果、谷歌和

sentences.en: Adobe, uh, uh, uh, when, you know, I submit my application on your job application, there's always a line that's, you know, where did you graduate high school?
sentences.zh: Adobe，呃，呃，呃，当你知道的，我在你们的求职申请表上提交申请时，总会有一栏写着，你知道的，你在哪里高中毕业的？

sentences.en: And I list my college degree and just write N.A.
sentences.zh: 于是我列出我的大学学位，然后直接写 N.A.

sentences.en: for not applicable for high school.
sentences.zh: 代表高中一项不适用。

sentences.en: They typically don't follow up with you've got the college degree.
sentences.zh: 他们通常不会因为你有了大学学位就追问。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: Every single time I've gotten a call from HR going, uh, no, we need what, what high school you graduated from.
sentences.zh: 每一次我都会接到人力资源的电话，说，呃，不行，我们需要知道你是从哪所高中毕业的。

sentences.en: And I'm like, I did not, uh, this, the one time I posed a problem was when I started, I, I was going to go into electrical engineering.
sentences.zh: 我说我没有，呃，唯一真正制造麻烦的一次是我刚开始打算读电气工程的时候。

sentences.en: I mentioned hardware projects.
sentences.zh: 我提到了硬件项目。

sentences.en: I liked hardware.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢硬件。

sentences.en: Uh, uh, my sister was, was an electrical engineering major, so I was going to go into electrical engineering.
sentences.zh: 呃，呃，我姐姐是主修电气工程的，所以我本来打算学电气工程。

sentences.en: So that's where I started.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我的起步。

sentences.en: And very quickly I decided that that was not for me and I would rather do computer science.
sentences.zh: 但很快我就决定那不适合我，我宁愿学计算机科学。

sentences.en: And so I was going to transfer to university of Washington, but they required that I had a high school diploma and I did not.
sentences.zh: 因此我打算转学到华盛顿大学，但他们要求必须有高中毕业证，而我没有。

sentences.en: So I could not transfer unless I dropped out of college and went back to high school for a year.
sentences.zh: 所以我没法转学，除非我从大学退学，回高中再读一年。

sentences.en: Uh, so that closed one door.
sentences.zh: 呃，所以这扇门算是关上了。

sentences.en: So I switched from double E to a business major of all things, uh, was horribly frustrated and bored.
sentences.zh: 于是我从电子工程转到了商业专业，真是活久见，当时觉得极其沮丧和无聊。

sentences.en: And then, uh, I found out that our school was going to start a computer science program.
sentences.zh: 然后，呃，我听说我们学校要开设计算机科学专业了。

sentences.en: So I went to my advisor and asked what it would take to get into the computer science program.
sentences.zh: 于是我去找指导老师，问要怎样才能进入计算机科学专业。

sentences.en: And they said, well, probably the best thing to do would be to switch to a math major
sentences.zh: 他们说，嗯，最好的办法可能是先转成数学专业

sentences.en: and, and that would get most of the requirements out of the way.
sentences.zh: 这样大部分先修要求就都能搞定了。

sentences.en: So I switched to a math major and it was a math major.
sentences.zh: 于是我转成了数学专业，并当了一阵子数学专业学生。

sentences.en: And then, uh, as soon as they started the computer science program, I switched to that.
sentences.zh: 然后，呃，他们一开设计算机科学专业，我就立刻转了过去。

sentences.en: So my last year was computer science.
sentences.zh: 所以我的最后一年学的是计算机科学。

sentences.en: And what was your degree?
sentences.zh: 那你拿的是什么学位？

sentences.en: So I got a degree in computer science, a minor in math and a specialty in AI of all things.
sentences.zh: 我拿到了计算机科学学位，辅修数学，还鬼使神差地专攻了人工智能。

sentences.en: Uh, but it bears no resemblance to today's AI.
sentences.zh: 呃，不过这和如今的人工智能毫无共同之处。

sentences.en: And there were 12 of us in our graduating class, first graduate, graduating class from, from, uh, computer science out of Seattle university.
sentences.zh: 我们毕业班一共只有12个人，是西雅图大学计算机科学专业的首届毕业生。

sentences.en: Two of us actually work at Adobe.
sentences.zh: 我们当中有两个人其实在Adobe工作。

sentences.en: I was going to say, do you, do you keep in touch?
sentences.zh: 我正想问，你们还有联系吗？

sentences.en: Or have any of them gone on to?
sentences.zh: 或者他们中间有没有人后来……？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: Um, uh, so let's see.
sentences.zh: 嗯，呃，让我想想。

sentences.en: I keep in touch with three from that class.
sentences.zh: 我和那个班的三个人保持着联系。

sentences.en: So, so, you know, four of 12, I guess, know each other.
sentences.zh: 所以，所以，12个人里有4个人彼此认识吧。

sentences.en: I think, I think some of the people who I keep in touch with, keep in touch with some of the other people.
sentences.zh: 我想，我和其中一些人保持联系，他们又和另外一些人保持联系。

sentences.en: Uh, it was a very eclectic course or, or, or a class.
sentences.zh: 呃，那是一个非常博杂的课程，或者说班级。

sentences.en: Uh, Seattle university is a Catholic university, uh, Jesuit, you know, one of our classmates had, had, uh, had been a Jesuit and then decided not to be a Jesuit.
sentences.zh: 呃，西雅图大学是一所天主教大学，呃，耶稣会创办的，你知道的，我们的一个同班同学曾经当过耶稣会士，后来决定不当了。

sentences.en: And so.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: Because of going to Seattle U?
sentences.zh: 是因为去了西雅图大学吗？

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: Had, had just, just, just decided to do something else and, and ended up in the computer science program.
sentences.zh: 只是，只是，只是决定做点别的，结果阴差阳错进了计算机科学专业。

sentences.en: And so we were, uh, let's see, we had class of 12.
sentences.zh: 所以我们，呃，让我想想，我们全班一共12个人。

sentences.en: We had, uh, uh, two women.
sentences.zh: 我们有，呃，呃，两个女生。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我想是这样没错。

sentences.en: Two.
sentences.zh: 两个。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Two women, uh, uh, 17% is better than is better than, uh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 两个女生，呃，呃，17%总比，总比，呃，好一些吧。

sentences.en: One of the people that I keep in touch with was, was an international student from Singapore.
sentences.zh: 我保持联系的其中一个人，曾经是来自新加坡的国际学生。

sentences.en: Uh, uh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 呃，呃，对。

sentences.en: So it was, it was quite the mix of people.
sentences.zh: 所以大家真的是形形色色什么人都有。

sentences.en: Uh, I keep in touch with some of them.
sentences.zh: 呃，我和他们中的一些人保持着联系。

sentences.en: Uh, we had three young, uh, college professors who had started the program who were basically freshly minted PhDs themselves, uh, which was, they decided to be a college student.
sentences.zh: 呃，我们有三位年轻的大学教授，他们刚创办这个项目，自己基本上也都是刚拿到博士学位不久，呃，这就好像他们决定重新当回大学生一样。

sentences.en: They decided collectively that they would teach every course in a different programming language, but not teach the programming language.
sentences.zh: 他们一致决定用不同的编程语言来教每一门课，但却不专门教这些编程语言。

sentences.en: So, so, so you took the course and they said, you know, we're doing, uh, uh, a course in, in graphics.
sentences.zh: 所以，所以，所以你上这门课时，他们会说，我们正在学，呃，呃，图形学课程。

sentences.en: It's going to be taught in Lisp.
sentences.zh: 将用Lisp语言教学。

sentences.en: Uh, uh, and so learn Lisp.
sentences.zh: 呃，呃，所以你们自己去学Lisp吧。

sentences.en: So, you know, a bunch of languages, you know, Lisp, Forth, Prolog, uh, C, Pascal, uh, Ingris,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，有一堆语言，Lisp、Forth、Prolog、呃，C、Pascal、呃，Ingres，

sentences.en: which was, uh, a pre-S, well, kind of competitor to SQL probably at the time, database language.
sentences.zh: 那是，呃，早期的一个S——好吧，当时差不多算是SQL的竞争对手，一种数据库语言。

sentences.en: Something called Startle, which was a register transfer language.
sentences.zh: 还有一个叫Startle的东西，是一种寄存器传输语言。

sentences.en: So just got this interesting and diverse education.
sentences.zh: 总之接受了这种有趣且多元的教育。

sentences.en: I know a couple of us of the 12 appreciated that.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们这12个人里有几个很感激这一点。

sentences.en: I think the majority did not, thought it was too weird.
sentences.zh: 我想大多数人并不喜欢，觉得太古怪了。

sentences.en: But the professors were also, I don't think any of them were married at the time.
sentences.zh: 不过那些教授们当时好像也都还没结婚。

sentences.en: So we would do things like they would say, well, we've got an exam tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 所以我们会遇到这种情况：他们会说，嗯，我们明天有考试。

sentences.en: And people were asking questions in class.
sentences.zh: 大家在课上问问题。

sentences.en: And the professor would say, well, why don't you guys just all come over to my apartment this evening.
sentences.zh: 教授就会说，好吧，那你们今晚干脆都去我公寓吧。

sentences.en: And we'll go through the material again and cover it.
sentences.zh: 我们把资料再过一遍，复习一下。

sentences.en: And so we'd end up all night hanging with a professor in their apartment going through the material.
sentences.zh: 于是我们最后就会通宵待在教授的公寓里一起复习资料。

sentences.en: So that was an amazing experience and kind of set the groundwork.
sentences.zh: 所以那是一段不可思议的经历，也为我打下了基础。

sentences.en: And then I got married while I was in college.
sentences.zh: 然后我在上大学期间结婚了。

sentences.en: And my wife was from Southern California.
sentences.zh: 我妻子来自南加州。

sentences.en: And her dad, my father-in-law, had a brain tumor.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲，也就是我的岳父，得了脑瘤。

sentences.en: And so kind of right after I graduated, we moved down to Southern California to be close to her family.
sentences.zh: 所以在快毕业的时候，我们搬到了南加州，以便离她的家人近一些。

sentences.en: And I was looking for jobs.
sentences.zh: 我当时在找工作。

sentences.en: And I got a job at a little company called Orange Micro, which was in Anaheim.
sentences.zh: 然后我在一家叫Orange Micro的小公司找到了一份工作，这家公司在阿纳海姆。

sentences.en: I was wondering when this was going to connect with one of the stories that I heard at some point.
sentences.zh: 我一直在想，这什么时候才能跟我以前听过的某个故事联系起来。

sentences.en: Yeah, so we never covered any of my early history.
sentences.zh: 对，所以我们从未聊过我早年经历的任何细节。

sentences.en: I was wondering that, I mean, we've heard so many of your stories.
sentences.zh: 我一直很好奇，我是说，我们听过你那么多故事。

sentences.en: And I do think at some point you told a story about growing up with like a lot of freedom.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实觉得你曾在某个时候讲过一个故事，关于你在极度自由的环境中长大。

sentences.en: You know, parents, they're not, you know, oh, the kids are out and they'll come back, whatever, at some point.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，父母不管，哦，孩子们在外面玩，反正到时候总会回来的。

sentences.en: And at no point did I wonder, wait, how did some person living out rurally, not in some metropolis?
sentences.zh: 我怎么也想不到，等等，一个住在农村而不是大都市的人是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: Like most of them, it's like, oh, we were next to some school that had the first suite of computers.
sentences.zh: 就像他们大多数人一样，哦，我们挨着某所学校，那里有第一套电脑设备。

sentences.en: And anyways, we've now sketched, but I'm surprised that in all the conversations we've had, that's never come up.
sentences.zh: 总之，我们现在大概勾勒出来了，但我很惊讶，在我们进行过的所有对话中，这件事从来没被提起过。

sentences.en: And it's a very unique, like how many people can say they had a parent that worked for a company that had one of the first programming courses and then not enough people signed up.
sentences.zh: 而且这非常独特，有多少人能说他们的父母曾在一家拥有首批编程课程之一的公司工作，而且当时报名的人还不够多？

sentences.en: And so the kids came along like it's not dissimilar, like I said earlier, from other stories about.
sentences.zh: 于是孩子们也跟着去了，就像我刚才说的，这和其他那些故事没什么不同。

sentences.en: So I was saying I was the only kid in that classroom.
sentences.zh: 所以我刚才说我是那个教室里唯一的孩子。

sentences.en: So even though they opened it up to families, I think there was maybe one other spouse and me.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管他们对家属开放，但我想大概只有一个家属和我在一起。

sentences.en: And it was, I think there were, you know, I remember that class being very sparsely populated.
sentences.zh: 而且，我觉得我记得那个班人非常少。

sentences.en: There were maybe eight of us in there.
sentences.zh: 里面大概只有八个人。

sentences.en: A computer class with no computers is.
sentences.zh: 没有电脑的计算机课简直是……

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So I ended up at Orange Micro.
sentences.zh: 所以我最后去了Orange Micro。

sentences.en: And from there I went to MacHack Conference, which I talk about a lot.
sentences.zh: 从那里我去了我经常谈起的MacHack大会。

sentences.en: An amazing conference.
sentences.zh: 一个了不起的会议。

sentences.en: Good friends of mine organized and ran that and ran the hat competition there.
sentences.zh: 我的好朋友们组织并运营了那场会议，还在那里举办了黑客松比赛。

sentences.en: And they were from Apple.
sentences.zh: 他们来自苹果公司。

sentences.en: Scott Boyd and Greg Marriott.
sentences.zh: 斯科特·博伊德（Scott Boyd）和格雷格·马里奥特（Greg Marriott）。

sentences.en: We just had lunch together the other day.
sentences.zh: 我们前几天刚一起吃过午饭。

sentences.en: Still very good friends.
sentences.zh: 依然是非常好的朋友。

sentences.en: And while I was there, I approached Darren Adler.
sentences.zh: 我在那里的时候，找到了达伦·阿德勒（Darren Adler）。

sentences.en: He's now like head of safari at Apple.
sentences.zh: 他现在好像是苹果Safari浏览器的负责人。

sentences.en: He's a boomeranger at Apple.
sentences.zh: 他是苹果的回巢员工。

sentences.en: He had gone and worked at Magic Cap.
sentences.zh: 他以前去Magic Cap工作过。

sentences.en: If you look up the history of that, he's one of those engineers.
sentences.zh: 如果你去查那段历史，他就是那些工程师之一。

sentences.en: And I knew him from magazine articles that he wrote.
sentences.zh: 我通过他写的一些杂志文章认识了他。

sentences.en: And I approached him at lunch, kind of the first day of the conference.
sentences.zh: 我在大会第一天的午餐时找到了他。

sentences.en: And I had an idea for a hack.
sentences.zh: 我当时有一个黑客项目的构思。

sentences.en: And I knew how to write part of it.
sentences.zh: 我知道怎么写一部分。

sentences.en: And I thought he would know how to write the other part.
sentences.zh: 我想他会知道怎么写另一部分。

sentences.en: And so I asked if he wanted to work on it together.
sentences.zh: 所以我问他愿不愿意一起合作。

sentences.en: And we spent like the next 72 hours writing code on a Mac Plus and 68K assembly language with no docs and just a debugger to figure out API calls.
sentences.zh: 于是我们花了接下来的72小时，在一台Mac Plus上用68K汇编语言编写代码，没有任何文档，仅凭一个调试器来琢磨API调用。

sentences.en: And got our hack running.
sentences.zh: 最后把我们的项目跑通了。

sentences.en: And like two weeks after that, I got a phone call from Apple asking if I wanted to go up and get an interview.
sentences.zh: 大约两周后，我接到了苹果的电话，问我想不想去面试。

sentences.en: And I think we've covered some of the stories of my early interview.
sentences.zh: 我想我们已经聊过我早期面试的一些故事了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that turned into a job at Apple.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这演变成了一份在苹果的工作。

sentences.en: And that turned into a job at Adobe.
sentences.zh: 后来又变成了在Adobe的工作。

sentences.en: Google, back to Adobe.
sentences.zh: 谷歌，然后又回到了Adobe。

sentences.en: And so that's how my career went.
sentences.zh: 我的职业生涯就是这样发展的。

sentences.en: I guess maybe as a final question, it's because it's, I mean, and also, too, across the chaotic last, whatever, two hours, a lot of stories haven't been told.
sentences.zh: 我想作为最后一个问题吧，因为，我是说，而且在过去这混乱的两个小时里，还有很多故事没讲呢。

sentences.en: Like, will the Photoshop 4, is that an at-the-bar story?
sentences.zh: 比如，Photoshop 4的事，那是个适合在酒吧聊的故事吗？

sentences.en: Or is that, not right now, but maybe at a later date, there's a, yeah, Bryce and I were chatting about that.
sentences.zh: 还是说，现在先不说，改天再聊？对，布赖斯和我之前聊过这个。

sentences.en: The Photoshop 4 story that we heard last night over dinner was astounding, astounding.
sentences.zh: 昨晚吃晚饭时听到的Photoshop 4的故事简直太惊人了，太惊人了。

sentences.en: So look forward to that, listener.
sentences.zh: 所以听众朋友们，敬请期待吧。

sentences.en: I guess, yeah, when I, when I,
sentences.zh: 我想，是的，当我，当我，

sentences.en: when you bring up MacHack, and then also, too, in the back of my head, I had, I know that you were a part of Smart Friends, and that was a thing.
